brief.summary: American prep and country: a navy blazer or tweed hacking jacket over a crisp oxford shirt, a cable-knit jumper, cream wide-leg or straight trousers, riding boots or loafers, a silk scarf and a camel coat. Worn by a younger wardrobe as the classic thread that steadies an eclectic mix — the oxford under the embellished jacket, the loafer with the printed skirt.
signatures: silk scarf tied at the neck
a worn leather belt and a canvas tote
silhouettes: tailored jacket over a straight or wide trouser
tucked shirt with a high waist
long coat over a fine knit
collar out over a crew knit
